steps.title: Prepare amphetamine injection solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve amphetamine in sterile saline to achieve a dose of 1 mg per kg body weight; ensure the solution is sterile and ready for intraperitoneal injection.

steps.title: Inject amphetamine intraperitoneally
steps.instruction: Using sterile technique, inject each animal intraperitoneally with the prepared amphetamine solution, minimizing handling stress.

steps.title: Habituate animals post‑injection
steps.instruction: Transfer injected animals to the behavior room and allow them to habituate for approximately 30 minutes to permit drug distribution and reduce stress‑related behaviors.

steps.title: Place animal in arena and start recording
steps.instruction: Gently place each animal individually into an open‑field arena that provides ample space for free movement; immediately begin continuous video capture with an overhead camera positioned to view the entire arena, ensuring full‑body movements are visible for a 10‑minute recording period.

steps.title: Review video and count rotations
steps.instruction: After the 10‑minute recording, review the video and manually count rotational events, defining a rotation as a complete 360° turn of the animal’s body in either direction.

steps.title: Clean arena between subjects
steps.instruction: Thoroughly clean and disinfect the arena after each animal’s session to eliminate scent marks and olfactory cues, maintaining a consistent environment for subsequent tests.
